question: vLLM NVFP4 block scale factor memory overhead percentage

sources.title: Half the Memory, Twice the Users: FP8 and NVFP4 KV Caches in vLLM ...
sources.snippet: Anyone quoting "4-bit = quarter the memory" is forgetting the scales. What each format actually stores NVFP4 is NVIDIA's microscaling format: each value is E2M1 (1 sign bit, 2 exponent bits, 1 mantissa bit), grouped into 16-element micro-blocks, each block carrying its own FP8 (E4M3) scale factor, plus a second-level FP32 scalar per tensor.
